title: Telecom, Channel Manager - US EAST COAST
description: This is a remote position. Job Description: Channel Sales Manager for COMTALK Telecom We are seeking a Channel Sales Manager to take our sales to the next level in Florida (East Coast). COMTALK Telecom is a VoIP operator founded in 1997, and we have evolved into a CloudPBX provider and MVNO for mobile services. We also do a lot of wholesale business with operators and carriers from around the world. As part of our sales team, you will be responsible for managing and developing relationships with our channel partners and bringing new B2B customers onboard in Florida and along the East Coast. You will be selling state-of-the-art communication solutions to businesses throughout the US, with unique selling points such as no long-term contracts, 24/7/365 customer care, and a 3-year full warranty on any VoIP equipment you sell. We are looking for a hunter by nature, who is not afraid to say "no" to a customer if we cannot fulfill their wishes 110%. You will spend most of your day on the phone with potential or existing clients, or visiting them at their place of business. A good deal requires a solid handshake, and you will be the first person on our new sales team in Fort Lauderdale. Therefore, you will have a significant influence on how the job should be shaped for yourself and the future team. Your customer care and support colleagues are located throughout the world, mainly in Europe, so email and CRM skills are a must. Requirements - Proven experience as a Channel Sales Manager - Excellent communication and negotiation skills - Ability to build rapport with customers and channel partners - Ability to work independently and as part of a team - Familiarity with CRM software and email communication - Willingness to travel Benefits You can choose to work from home or from our office at Regus (E. Sunrise Blvd., Fort Lauderdale) , it is all up to you. We would like to tell you much more, but take a look at or That will you an idea, about what we do The benefits we offer, among others are Solid base salary Personal Sales bonus Team sales bonus "End of financial year bonus" Healthcare Pension If you are still hooked, please send us an application, ***Please note a spotless criminal record, is required to be apply for this position*** Originally posted on Himalayas

Procuramos alguém com grande vontade de ensinar e de se juntar ao desafio de fazer parte de uma equipa que gosta de assumir riscos, adaptar-se a mudanças e é amante da inovação. Em poucas palavras, será responsável por ensinar e motivar os nossos alunos no seu novo desafio: a Universidade! Se gosta de explicar, sente-se à vontade com tecnologias e é apaixonado por educação, este é o seu lugar! A motivação e o compromisso são o nosso motor, por isso procuramos alguém que partilhe essa paixão e entusiasmo pelo que faz. É um deles? Quais serão as suas responsabilidades? title: Java Engineer – Application / Database Modernization
description: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores ' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. Enterprises stuck on Oracle carry license renewals, vendor-specific SQL nobody wants to touch, and application layers welded to the database underneath them. This role sits in our Application & Database Modernization pillar: you'll work an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration where Aedeon handles the mechanical conversion at scale and you own what the tools can't the refactoring judgment inside large enterprise Java codebases. You'll rewrite the SQL the application actually depends on, align it with the modernized schema, prove functional parity, and see the application through production cutover. Not a proof of concept. A system that ships. What you will do? Analyze and remediate large enterprise Java codebases — replace legacy and database-specific SQL constructs with modern, standards-compliant SQL. Convert embedded SQL in Java services and MyBatis XML mappers: rewrite vendor-specific functions, sequences, pagination logic, dynamic SQL, and error-handling patterns. Work closely with schema and database migration engineers so application-layer SQL lands aligned with the modernized target schema. Refactor Java transaction logic, error handling, drivers, and ORM/DAO layers to match the behavior of modern databases. Run unit, integration, and performance testing to confirm functional parity and hit performance SLAs post-modernization. Support production cutover — validation, monitoring setup, rollback planning, and stabilization until the system holds. Produce engineering documentation that outlives the engagement: SQL remediation guides, code-migration runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-transfer material for customer teams. Work across distributed teams (US and India) and with customer SMEs to keep business logic aligned and the modernization on track. What are we looking for? Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of professional Java development experience (Spring, JDBC, MyBatis/Hibernate or equivalent). Experience with application modernization, database migrations, or large-scale refactoring initiatives. Strong SQL expertise you can analyze, interpret, optimize, and rewrite complex SQL embedded in Java applications. Deep understanding of JDBC, ORMs, Java transaction patterns, and database-driven application flows. Experience on enterprise-grade, high-performance applications

Entity Ingestion : Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles. Editorial Signal Weighting : Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations. Query Optimization : Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents. Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent. Qui peut participer à l’étude ? Pour participer, vous devez remplir les conditions suivantes : Avoir 18 ans ou plus. Être né(e) et vivre en France ou outre-mer. Être en mesure d’utiliser un téléphone portable pour ce projet. Pouvoir utiliser un casque filaire ou le microphone de l’appareil pour enregistrer des phrases. Avoir accès à un environnement intérieur calme pour effectuer les enregistrements. Notes: Dans le cadre de ce projet, nous recherchons des participants issus de groupes démographiques spécifiques afin de contribuer au développement d’une technologie impartiale qui soit représentative de tous. Certains groupes sont déjà complets, mais nous recherchons toujours des voix masculines avec des accents du Nord, du Nord-est, du Sud-ouest et du Sud-est de la France. Nous recherchons aussi des participants issus d’outre-mer: Guadeloupe (971), Martinique (972), Guyane (973), La Réunion (974), Mayotte (976), Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (975), Saint-Barthélemy (977), Saint-Martin (978), Wallis-et-Futuna (986), Polynésie française (987), Nouvelle-Calédonie (988), Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (984) et Clipperton (989). title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Senior Backend Engineer About us We're creating the foundational backend systems that power private market access, from secure authentication and transaction processing to portfolio management and regulatory compliance. The Role We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own the systems where money moves and balances have to be correct — the ledger, transaction processing, and the settlement and reconciliation workflows behind our platform. This is the correctness core of what we build. If a balance is wrong, a transaction double-processes, or a reconciliation silently drifts, nothing else we build matters. You'll design the double-entry ledger, the money-movement engine, and the long-running state machines that carry complex financial workflows to completion reliably over hours, days, or weeks. You'll reason about idempotency, concurrency, partial failure, and replay as a matter of habit, not as an afterthought. You'll own core infrastructure decisions and set the standard for how we build financial systems. Requirements What You'll Do Design and build the double-entry ledger and money-movement engine that all transactions reconcile against Model complex financial workflows as robust, observable state machines that run reliably over long periods Guarantee financial correctness under concurrency: idempotent operations, transactional integrity, and reconciliation that ties out to the cent Handle partial-failure and replay cases so no event is lost, duplicated, or applied twice Build secure, well-versioned APIs Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and data models Debug production issues and own the reliability of mission-critical financial workflows What We're Looking For 5+ years of backend development on production systems Demonstrated money-movement correctness experience: you've built a ledger, settlement system, payments core, or transaction-processing system and can talk in detail about how you kept it correct Concurrency and idempotency depth: you can explain, from experience, how you handled double-processing, race conditions on balances, and replay Reconciliation experience: you've built or owned systems that had to tie out exactly, and you know what happens when they don't Strong TDD practices: you write tests first and maintain comprehensive coverage Domain-Driven Design expertise: you model complex financial domains accurately Deep PostgreSQL knowledge: schema design, transactions, isolation levels, optimization Strong in a modern backend stack: we work in TypeScript/Node.js, Go and on the JVM ecosystem; we value real depth in either and the range to pick up the other • Cloud deployment experience Startup mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, high autonomy, driving solutions without detailed specs Nice to Have Payments, banking, brokerage, or investment-platform systems experience Securities, custody, or portfolio/NAV domain knowledge Event-driven architectures and message queues Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)

title: AI Tech Lead, Remote (based in Europe)
description: Virtusan is a Swiss based health coaching platform for sleep, stress and recovery that works with any wearable, including our own smart ring. We're hiring our first AI Tech Lead to build the intelligence behind our coach: turning biometric and behavioural signals into personalised programmes that help people sleep better and stress less. You’ll be the technical authority for AI across engineering; you make the calls on architecture and approach, set the standards others build to and stay hand-on in the code. What you'll be doing 1) Signal interpretation: Turn wearable and in-app data into recovery, stress and sleep insights, using personal baselines and trend detection. 2) Multi-device data: Normalise metrics across vendors, weight sources by reliability, and handle missing data and device switches. 3) Recommendation engine: Personalise protocol sequences by dose and timing with classical ML (e.g. contextual bandits, sequential recommenders or RL). 4) Feedback loops: Learn from real user behaviour and biometric responses which protocols work, and for whom. 5) Evaluation: Offline metrics, online experiments and production monitoring for every model and LLM feature. 6) AI platform: Own the roadmap, training and serving pipelines, data quality and architecture on our Python and Azure stack. 7) Technical leadership: Make and own the key architecture and modelling decisions, and write them down (RFCs, ADRs etc.) so the team can build them. 8) Privacy: Make secure handling of sensitive health data part of the design from the start. 9) Collaboration: Help product, design and marketing shape AI features and understand what the models can and can't do. Hands on: This is a builder role. You’ll be prototyping, evaluating and taking code through to production. Requirements 6+ years in ML/AI engineering incl. 2+ years in a lead role, with at least one product taken from zero to production Python, FastAPI and production MLOps on Azure or another major cloud Time series, recommender systems, causal/uplift methods and strong statistics A/B testing, model evaluation and production monitoring LLMs and LangGraph (or similar) on Azure OpenAI, and knowing when not to use them Experience as a tech lead or staff engineer, making technical decisions that a team of engineers followed. Privacy-aware handling of health data Based in Europe and fluent in English Nice to have: bandits, RL or off-policy evaluation; health or wearable data; literature mining; AI in engineering workflows (coding agents, AI-assisted testing, CI). Application process Instead of a cover letter, please send us the answers to 2 of the following 3 questions together with your CV. 1) Tell us about an ML product you took from zero to production. What did you own, and what changed because of it? 2) You have a recommendation engine and want to know whether a protocol actually improves users' sleep. How would you measure that? 3) Tell us about a technical decision you made for a team that others disagreed

description: Deine Rolle Wir sind HeyHoney, ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer treuen Community und einem klaren Produkt.
